tools.name: create_explainer_video
tools.description: Explainer video: Take one idea and make it land. We open on the question, explain the mechanism, and pay it off. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

topic.description: What do you want to explain?. One idea explains better than five. Narrow beats broad.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_listicle_video
tools.description: List video: Numbered tips, ranked picks, or things people get wrong. Each item gets its own scene. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

count.description: How many items?. We will write fewer if the topic only supports fewer real items.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_story_video
tools.description: Story video: Open inside the moment, escalate, reveal. Built for history, mysteries and true events. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_ugc_video
tools.description: UGC-style ad: Reads like a real recommendation, not an advert. Cold open, honest caveat, soft close. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_demo_video
tools.description: Product demo: Show the job getting done, step by step, and end on the result. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_article_video
tools.description: Article to video: Paste a blog post, newsletter or any writing. We select the spine and turn it into a short. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

source.description: Paste the article. We use only what is in your text. Nothing is invented or added.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: create_spokesperson_video
tools.description: Spokesperson video: One presenter, straight to camera, for announcements and messages from you. Costs credits (use estimate_video_cost first). Returns a video id immediately; the render takes minutes - poll get_video_status.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-sending the same key returns the SAME video instead of creating (and charging for) a second one. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: estimate_video_cost
tools.description: Free. Quote the credit cost of a video before creating it. Same tools and arguments as the create_* tools.

tool.description: Which create tool the video would use.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Check one video's progress. Returns status, a progress note, and download_url when ready. Respect poll_after_seconds between calls.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: List this account's videos (id, title, status). Use it to recover a video id rather than guessing one.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Free. Who this key belongs to: user, organization, plan, scopes and the live credit balance. Call first to confirm the connection works.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Free. The organization's credit balance: allowance, bonus, used (including in-flight reservations) and remaining.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: A signed URL for a finished video's MP4, valid 15 minutes. Only works once get_video_status reports ready.

tools.name: cancel_video
tools.description: Stop a render that is still generating and release its reserved credits. Cannot undo a finished video.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: Free. Curated voices plus a filtered slice of the full catalog. Filters: gender, accent, age, use_case. Returns ids usable in future voice options.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: Free. Preset and workspace characters (id, name, style, image url).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Free. The template library (id, title, which create tool it maps to).

tools.name: write_script
tools.description: Write the script only (no video, no render credits): title, hook and scenes with narration and visual directions. Give a topic, or a tool + fields from the create tools. Edit it, then create_video_from_script.

topic.description: Free-text topic. Use this OR tool+fields.

fields.description: The tool's brief fields by name.

tools.name: create_video_from_script
tools.description: Render a video from a script you already have (from write_script, structure_text, or your own). Costs credits. Returns a video id; poll get_video_status.

script.description: The script object: title, hook, scenes[{scene_number, narration, visual_description, duration_seconds, scene_type?}], total_duration_seconds, hashtags?

start_generation.description: Default true. false saves a draft; call generate_video later.

idempotency_key.description: Same key = same video. Set it when retrying.

tools.name: structure_text
tools.description: Turn prose or a hand-written script into our structured scene script (free apart from a small AI cost). Then create_video_from_script.

tools.name: fetch_article
tools.description: Fetch a public article's readable text so you can brief the article tool from a URL.

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Edit a video's title, topic, script or caption settings. Script edits apply on the next generate_video.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start or re-run generation for a draft, or after update_video edits. Costs credits.

tools.name: regenerate_scene
tools.description: Redo one scene's visuals, optionally with new narration. Costs credits.

tools.name: regenerate_voice
tools.description: Re-record the voiceover with another voice (from list_voices). Costs credits.

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Export (render) the video again after edits. Returns a render id; poll get_video_status.

tools.name: get_captions
tools.description: The finished video's captions as SRT or VTT text.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: A public, expiring link to the finished MP4 for people without an account (default 24h, max 7 days).

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Delete a video and its files. Irreversible. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: generate_ideas
tools.description: Scored video ideas for a niche and audience.

tools.name: enhance_prompt
tools.description: Rewrite a rough topic into a stronger brief before creating.

tools.name: generate_character_portraits
tools.description: Generate 1-4 portrait candidates for a new character from a description. Costs credits. Returns r2_key values to pass to create_character.

tools.name: generate_voice_previews
tools.description: Candidate voices for a new character reading a sample line. Returns voice ids and preview temp keys for create_character.

tools.name: create_character
tools.description: Save a character from a chosen portrait (r2_key) and voice preview (temp key + voice id).

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate a background track (15, 30 or 60 seconds) from a prompt and mood. Use the returned id as music_id when creating a video.

tools.name: list_music
tools.description: Free. Your generated background tracks.

tools.name: preview_voice
tools.description: Hear a voice say your text (up to 500 characters). Returns a 1-hour audio URL.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Receive video.created / video.ready / video.failed / character.created / post.published / post.partially_failed / post.failed at a public https URL instead of polling. The signing secret is returned once.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Free. Your webhooks and their delivery health.

tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.description: Free. The social accounts this workspace has connected (id acc_..., platform, name, can_post, needs_reconnection), the plan's account limit (limit, used), and every platform with how it connects. Platforms: TikTok, Instagram (posts as a Reel), YouTube (posts as a Short), Facebook (Pages only), LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram and Discord. X is not available. Call this before publish_video to get account ids; never guess them. An account with can_post false or needs_reconnection true must be reconnected by the user in the web app before posting.

tools.name: get_connect_link
tools.description: Get a short-lived link that connects one social account. A PERSON must open the link in a browser and approve access; you cannot complete it yourself, so give the link to the user and ask them to open it. Then call list_social_accounts to see the new account. Works for tiktok, instagram (posts as a Reel; uses Instagram login, not Facebook), youtube (posts as a Short), facebook (Pages only), linkedin, threads and pinterest. Bluesky, Telegram and Discord connect with credentials in the web app only (Accounts page): tell the user to connect them there. X is not available. Refused when the plan's account limit is reached.

tools.name: publish_video
tools.description: Post a finished video (status ready) to one or more connected social accounts, now or at a scheduled time. This posts publicly on the user's real accounts: confirm the accounts and caption with the user first. Asynchronous: returns a post id (pub_...) at once; then poll get_publish_status until done is true (respect poll_after_seconds). Platforms: TikTok, Instagram (posts as a Reel), YouTube (posts as a Short), Facebook (Pages only), LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram and Discord. X is not available. Set idempotency_key when retrying so the video is not posted twice.

video_id.description: Public video id, e.g. vid_abc123. Must be ready.

caption.description: Caption for every platform (hashtags included). Max 10000 characters.

caption_overrides.description: Optional. A different caption per platform, keyed by platform id (e.g. {"linkedin": "..."}). Replaces caption on that platform only.

youtube_title.description: Optional. YouTube title (max 100). Default: the video's own title.

scheduled_for.description: Optional. ISO 8601 time to post at (for example 2026-10-01T15:00:00Z). Omit to post now. Posts go out within about 2 minutes of the time.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone for the schedule, e.g. Europe/London.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key within 24 hours returns the same post instead of posting again.

tools.name: get_publish_status
tools.description: Status of one publish (post id pub_... from publish_video). status: preparing, importing, pending, scheduled, publishing, then published, partial or failed (done = true). Each destination has platform, status (pending, published, failed), url (the live post, when published) and error. Respect poll_after_seconds.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Free. Past and scheduled publishes, newest first, with per-destination results and live post URLs. Filter by video_id. Paginate with cursor (next_cursor from the previous call).
